Summary:

The outages impacted services in the following regions and availability zones:

 Frankfurt (eu-central1)
 London (eu-west2)
 US-East (us-east-1)
 Sydney (au-syd)

The outages started on 25 May 2021 13:33 UTC and lasted for 12 hours and 7 minutes.

The root cause of the outage was resource constraints in HA Proxy Load Balancers caused by an abnormally high burst of database queries from Private DNS.

The downtime period was marked as resolved on 26 May 2021 01:40 UTC.

However, I can provide a summary of the incident:

The IBM Cloud Console was impacted by a DDoS attack on 24 October 2023. The outage started at 06:42 UTC and lasted for 5 hours and 30 minutes. The root cause of the outage was a highly distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack that partially bypassed existing protections.

Overall Summary

The AWS services in Northern Virginia (us-east-1) Region experienced an outage on July 30, 2024. The outage started at 14:45 UTC and lasted for approximately 7 hours and 36 minutes. The root cause was a degradation of one of the internally-used cells of Amazon Kinesis Data Streams service.
